T1.name: Uphill hairpin
T1.features: The outside of the hairpin has broad painted runoff. The downhill exit curb is a useful landmark for throttle pickup.

T2.name: Downhill right
T2.features: The sweeping right follows the T1 downhill exit. The inside curb and the longer outside runoff run through different parts of the arc.

T3.name: Esses entry
T3.features: This left starts the esses. The red, white and blue runoff outside the bend continues toward T5.

T4.name: Esses right
T4.features: The right-hand apex sits opposite the red outside paint. Gold marks a documented real-event turtle zone with approximate placement.

T5.name: Esses left
T5.features: The curb, green paint and adjacent tricolor runoff are distinct surfaces. Gold marks the approximate real-event turtle zone.

T6.name: Long right
T6.features: The long right leads into the 6A shortcut. Blue runoff and the red-and-white curb are distinct surfaces. The turtle zone is approximate.

6A.name: Shortcut hairpin
6A.features: The sharp left leaves the Grand Prix route toward 6B. The approach fans out and the shortcut pavement changes shade. Surface edges here are schematic.

6B.name: Back-straight merge
6B.features: The shortcut turns left onto the back straight. Local curb and runoff placement are approximate.

T12.name: Back-straight braking
T12.features: The back straight feeds the left into the stadium. Broad red, white and blue runoff sits outside the braking corner.

T13.name: Stadium right
T13.features: The first stadium right wraps the end of the straight from T12. Green runoff sits outside the bending section.

T14.name: Stadium transition
T14.features: This short right transitions toward T15. The tight spacing makes the green paint and curb easy to confuse in an onboard view.

T15.name: Stadium hairpin
T15.features: The left hairpin wraps around the painted stadium runoff, then leads toward the carousel.

T16.name: Carousel entry
T16.features: First part of the continuous right-hand carousel. The outer tricolor runoff starts on the approach.

T17.name: Carousel center
T17.features: Middle of the continuous right-hand carousel. The inside curb and outer tricolor runoff carry through the arc.

T18.name: Carousel exit
T18.features: Final part of the carousel before the run to T19. The painted outside shoulder continues down the exit.

T16\u2013T18.name: Carousel
T16\u2013T18.features: Read the three right-hand apex zones in sequence. The shared colored runoff follows the outer arc.

T19.name: Late left
T19.features: The late left leads across to the final corner. Approaching from the carousel, pick up the inside curb and outside exit paint.

T20.name: Final left
T20.features: The final left opens onto the front straight. The outside exit curb follows the direction of travel.
